review_rules: Akaviri peoples must remain distinct; do not treat Tsaesci, Kamal, Ka Po' Tun and Tang Mo as interchangeable descriptions of one culture
Claims about Tsaesci physical nature are contradictory and often mediated by outsider texts; preserve competing interpretations
2920 is historical fiction and provides evidence for cultural memory/literary tradition, not automatic verbatim First Era history
Reman birth and divine-origin narratives in the Remanada retain mythic/propagandistic provenance
Distinguish the First and Second Akaviri invasions and their different peoples, motives and evidence
Cross-link existing Reman, Second Empire, Akaviri Potentate, Dragonguard, Jorunn, Almalexia, Wulfharth and Second Akaviri Invasion records
